outcome_blind_statement: No coefficient from the new turn-coupling models had been inspected when this contract was drafted. Previously published project-level marginal results were known.

sample_roles.parent_only: gated sensitivity after file-level participant-role validation

eligibility.primary: primary_eligible == 1 in the frozen downstream handoff
eligibility.sensitivity: sensitivity_eligible == 1 in the frozen downstream handoff

estimands.interpretation: momentary caregiver-to-child predictability coupling at fixed child effort

frequentist_inventory.primary: three k3 model families in PBM discovery, other-58 confirmation, and all-79 descriptive scopes
frequentist_inventory.decomposition_sensitivities: k0 and context-support variants of F1-F3 in the pooled all-79 scope only
frequentist_inventory.coupling_shape: penalized smooth plus tensor interaction with age
frequentist_inventory.primary_decision: two-sided simultaneous interval for the supported age-specific within-session coupling curve

frequentist_formulas.F1: score_outcome ~ s(age_z,k=8,bs='cr') + s(predictor_within_z,k=6,bs='cr') + ti(age_z,predictor_within_z,k=c(6,6),bs=c('cr','cr')) + c_word_top12 + s(log1p_a0_words,k=6,bs='cr') + s(predictor_child_mean,k=6,bs='cr') + a0_question_type + exact_imitation_candidate + child_backchannel_candidate + session_reading_candidate + session_routine_candidate + s(dataset,bs='re') + s(child_key,bs='re') + s(child_session_key,bs='re')
frequentist_formulas.F2: c_words ~ s(age_z,k=8,bs='cr') + s(predictor_within_z,k=6,bs='cr') + ti(age_z,predictor_within_z,k=c(6,6),bs=c('cr','cr')) + s(log1p_a0_words,k=6,bs='cr') + s(predictor_child_mean,k=6,bs='cr') + a0_question_type + exact_imitation_candidate + child_backchannel_candidate + session_reading_candidate + session_routine_candidate + s(dataset,bs='re') + s(child_key,bs='re') + s(child_session_key,bs='re')
frequentist_formulas.F3: a1_words ~ s(age_z,k=8,bs='cr') + s(predictor_within_z,k=6,bs='cr') + ti(age_z,predictor_within_z,k=c(6,6),bs=c('cr','cr')) + s(log1p_c_words,k=6,bs='cr') + s(log1p_a0_words,k=6,bs='cr') + s(a0_control_within_z,k=6,bs='cr') + s(predictor_child_mean,k=6,bs='cr') + c_question_type + a0_question_type + exact_imitation_candidate + child_backchannel_candidate + session_reading_candidate + session_routine_candidate + s(dataset,bs='re') + s(child_key,bs='re') + s(child_session_key,bs='re')

confirmation_rule: For each F1-F3 k3 family, the other-58 simultaneous 95% coupling band must exclude zero at two adjacent registered ages; discovery sign agreement at overlapping ages is reported separately and is not used to replace the confirmation estimate.

bayesian.first_stage: joint child-level linear summaries with shared session-clustered covariance; age centered at 42 months

first_stage_formulas.adult_to_child_k3: z(c_k3_bits) ~ age_z + a0_k3_within_z + age_z:a0_k3_within_z + log1p_c_words + log1p_a0_words + z(a0_k3_child_mean)
first_stage_formulas.adult_to_child_effort: z(log1p_c_words) ~ age_z + a0_k3_within_z + age_z:a0_k3_within_z + log1p_a0_words + z(a0_k3_child_mean)
first_stage_formulas.child_to_adult_effort: z(log1p_a1_words) ~ age_z + c_k3_within_z + age_z:c_k3_within_z + log1p_c_words + log1p_a0_words + a0_k3_within_z + z(c_k3_child_mean)

bayesian.prior_source: weakly regularizing standardized-scale priors; PBM estimates are not used as priors

interpretation_guardrails: Use caregiver unless participant metadata establish parent identity.
Coupling is observational prediction or accommodation, not a causal effect.
Lower surprisal is scorer predictability, not greater Shannon information.
Shorter speech is not efficiency without downstream value or validated function.
Never enter k0, k3, and k0-k3 together in one model.
Do not pool raw bits across tokenizers.
